name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIUM_SERVICES_UPDATE

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIUM_SERVICES_UPDATE_DESCRIPTION
context: Description of the toggle for automatic update downloads

name: IDS_SETTINGS_HELIUM_SERVICES_UBO_DESCRIPTION
context: Description of the toggle for automatic update downloads
message: Helium Neo will fetch fresh filter lists for uBlock Origin. All requests to lists are proxied to protect your privacy. When disabled, default filter lists will be loaded from local storage, which are only updated along with Helium Neo. Optional filter lists will be requested without proxying.

context: Tooltip explaining why a listed service is marked as a Helium Neo partner.
message: Paying for this service will support the development of Helium Neo.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_WELCOME_GREETING
context: Main greeting on the first onboarding screen.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_WELCOME_BODY
context: Introductory body text on the first onboarding screen.
message: Configure Helium Neo to match your taste and import data from other browsers. Make it feel like home or jump straight to browsing.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_WELCOME_TERMS
context: Legal note shown during onboarding. Keep each BEGIN/END placeholder pair around its corresponding link text, but move the pairs as needed for a natural translation.
message: By continuing, you agree to the <ph name="BEGIN_LINK_PRIVACY">$1</ph>privacy policy<ph name="END_LINK_PRIVACY">$2</ph> and <ph name="BEGIN_LINK_TERMS">$3</ph>terms of use<ph name="END_LINK_TERMS">$4</ph>.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_WELCOME_FOOTER
context: Footer text explaining that setup can be skipped but Helium Neo services require consent.
message: If you use defaults, Helium Neo services will be automatically enabled.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_FINISH_TITLE
context: Title on the final onboarding screen.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_FINISH_BODY
context: Body text on the final onboarding screen.
message: The setup is complete, thank you for choosing Helium Neo. Time to enjoy the internet again.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_TITLE
context: Title of the onboarding screen for Helium Neo services consent.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_SUBTITLE
context: Subtitle explaining when Helium Neo services consent choices take effect.
message: Services are not active until you consent to using them. Changes will be applied after you go to the next page.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_CONNECTION_TITLE
context: Title of the global toggle for connecting to Helium Neo services.
message: Allow connecting to Helium Neo services

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_CONNECTION_DESC
context: Description of the global Helium Neo services toggle.
message: Helium Neo services provide additional functionality, such as: extension downloads, native !bangs, filter list updates, and browser updates. When disabled, none of these features will work, but Helium Neo will not make any web requests.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_BANGS_TITLE
context: Title of the toggle for downloading the Helium Neo bangs list.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_BANGS_DESC
context: Description of the toggle for downloading the Helium Neo bangs list.
message: Helium Neo will fetch a list of bangs that help you browse the Internet faster, such as !w or !gh. When disabled, bangs will not work.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_EXTENSIONS_TITLE
context: Title of the toggle for proxying extension downloads and updates.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_EXTENSIONS_DESC
context: Description of the toggle for proxying extension downloads and updates.
message: When enabled, Helium Neo will proxy extension downloads and updates to protect your privacy. When disabled, downloading and updating extensions will not work.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_UBLOCK_TITLE
context: Title of the toggle for downloading uBlock Origin filter lists.
message: Allow downloading filter lists for uBlock Origin

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_UBLOCK_DESC
context: Description of the toggle for downloading uBlock Origin filter lists.
message: Helium Neo will fetch fresh filter lists for uBlock Origin. All requests to lists are proxied to protect your privacy. When disabled, default filter lists will be loaded from local storage, which are only updated along with Helium Neo. Optional filter lists will be requested without proxying.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_AUTOUPDATES_TITLE
context: Title of the toggle for automatic browser updates on platforms where Helium Neo updates the browser.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_AUTOUPDATES_DESC
context: Description of the toggle for automatic browser updates on platforms where Helium Neo updates the browser.
message: Helium Neo will automatically check for updates and install them. This includes browser and component updates. We recommend keeping this setting enabled to ensure you get the latest features and security updates.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_AUTOUPDATES_TITLE_LINUX
context: Title of the toggle for automatic component updates on Linux.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_AUTOUPDATES_DESC_LINUX
context: Description of the toggle for automatic component updates on Linux.
message: Helium Neo will automatically check for component updates and install them. We recommend keeping this setting enabled. On Linux, browser updates are handled by your distro's package manager. Please check for Helium Neo package updates at least every week.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_SPELLCHECK_TITLE
context: Title of the toggle for downloading spell check dictionary files.
message: Allow downloading dictionary files for spell checking

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_SPELLCHECK_DESC
context: Description of the toggle for downloading spell check dictionary files.
message: Helium Neo will fetch dictionary files used for spell checking when requested. When disabled, spell checking will not work.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_INSTANCE_TITLE
context: Title of the option describing custom Helium Neo services instances.
message: Use your own instance of Helium Neo services

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SERVICES_INSTANCE_DESC
context: Description of the option describing custom Helium Neo services instances.
message: You can host your own instance of Helium Neo services and use it in your browser instead of the pre-hosted server. If you have one, you can set it in Helium Neo settings.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_TITLE
context: Title of the onboarding screen for selecting a default search engine.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_SUBTITLE
context: Subtitle for the onboarding screen for selecting a default search engine.
message: You can change your choice later in Settings. Search engines are sorted by privacy.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_CATEGORIES_PRIVATE
context: Description for privacy-first search engines in onboarding.
message: A privacy-first search engine which doesn't profile or track you.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_CATEGORIES_SMALL
context: Description for smaller search engines that are more private than mainstream engines but not privacy-focused.
message: Transparent, but not privacy-focused. Offers better privacy than mainstream search engines.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_CATEGORIES_MAINSTREAM
context: Description for mainstream search engines in onboarding.
message: A mainstream search engine which collects extensive personal data.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_CATEGORIES_CUSTOM
context: Description for a custom search engine in onboarding.
message: A custom search engine. Its privacy wasn't verified by Helium Neo.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_ENGINES_DUCKDUCKGO
context: Onboarding description of DuckDuckGo as a search engine option.
message: Privacy-focused. Relies on Bing for results. Promises not to track or profile you.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_ENGINES_KAGI
context: Onboarding description of Kagi as a search engine option.
message: Privacy-focused. Doesn't use Google or Bing. Has custom ranking. Requires a paid account. No ads, tracking, or profiling.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_ENGINES_QWANT
context: Onboarding description of Qwant as a search engine option.
message: Based in Europe. Relies on Bing for results. Sends tracking data to Microsoft.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_ENGINES_ECOSIA
context: Onboarding description of Ecosia as a search engine option.
message: May plant trees for clicking ads. Relies on Google and Bing for results. Sends tracking data to Google and Microsoft.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_ENGINES_BING
context: Onboarding description of Bing as a search engine option.
message: Collects extensive personal data. Privacy controls are buried and limited. Subjectively overwhelming UI.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_ENGINES_GOOGLE
context: Onboarding description of Google as a search engine option.
message: It's Google. It dominates the search market, collects extensive personal data, and profiles you.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_ENGINES_STARTPAGE
context: Onboarding description of Startpage as a search engine option.
message: Privacy-focused. Relies on Google and Bing for results. Promises not to track or profile you.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_SEARCH_ENGINES_BRAVE
context: Onboarding description of Brave as a search engine option.
message: Privacy-focused. Doesn't use Google or Bing. Promises not to track or profile you. May show promotions related to Brave services.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DEFAULT_BROWSER_TITLE
context: Title of the onboarding screen asking whether Helium Neo should be the default browser.
message: Ready to switch to Helium Neo?

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DEFAULT_BROWSER_SUBTITLE
context: Subtitle of the onboarding screen asking whether Helium Neo should be the default browser.
message: Better privacy, speed, and comfort. All in one click. Wanna make links open in Helium Neo by default?

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DEFAULT_BROWSER_YES
context: Label for the option to make Helium Neo the default browser.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DEFAULT_BROWSER_NO
context: Label for the option to keep the current default browser.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DEFAULT_BROWSER_YES_DESC
context: Description for the option to make Helium Neo the default browser.
message: Make Helium Neo my default browser.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DEFAULT_BROWSER_NO_DESC
context: Description for the option to keep the current default browser.
message: Just trying Helium Neo for now.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_TITLE
context: Title of the onboarding screen for importing browser data.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_SUBTITLE
context: Subtitle of the onboarding screen for importing browser data.
message: Transfer your bookmarks, history, and extensions from other browsers.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_PROMPT_TITLE
context: Title of the prompt asking to look for other browsers before showing import options.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_PROMPT_PERMISSION
context: Explanation asking for permission to look for other browsers before choosing data to import.
message: Allow Helium Neo to look for other browsers on this device so you can choose what to transfer.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_ALLOW
context: Button that allows Helium Neo to look for browsers to import data from.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_REFRESH
context: Accessible label and tooltip for the icon-only button that looks for browsers to import data from again, after the user has changed macOS permissions.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_NO_BROWSERS
context: Notice shown when no previous browsers are available to import data from.
message: No compatible browsers could be found.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_DISCOVERY_ERROR
context: Error shown when looking for browsers fails. The user can retry using the Allow button.
message: An error occurred. Please try again.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_MAC_NOTICE_TITLE
context: Title of the macOS-only banner below browser import options.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_MAC_NOTICE_BODY
context: Explanation of macOS browser detection permissions. Keep the BEGIN/END placeholder pair around the System Settings link, but move it as needed for a natural translation.
message: macOS protects some browsers from being automatically detected. To see more options, allow Helium Neo to access them in <ph name="BEGIN_LINK_SETTINGS">$1</ph>System Settings<ph name="END_LINK_SETTINGS">$2</ph>.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_BOOKMARKS
context: Label for bookmarks as an importable data type.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_HISTORY
context: Label for history as an importable data type.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_DATA_IMPORT_EXTENSIONS
context: Label for extensions as an importable data type.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_TITLE
context: Title of the onboarding screen for choosing a password manager.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_SUBTITLE
context: Subtitle of the onboarding screen for choosing a password manager.
message: Helium Neo doesn't have a built-in password manager. Would you like to install one from the Web Store?

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_IMPORT_GUIDE
context: Link label linking to a password manager import guide. Short title for a guide.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_SETUP_GUIDE
context: Link label linking to a password manager setup guide. Short title for a guide.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_PRIVACY
context: Link label linking to a password manager privacy policy. Short title for privacy policy.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_INSTALL
context: Button label to install a password manager extension, CTA.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_INSTALLED
context: Status label shown when a password manager extension is installed.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_ERROR
context: Prefix label shown before a password manager install error.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_MANAGERS_PROTON_PASS
context: Onboarding description of Proton Pass as a password manager option.
message: Secure and privacy-focused password manager with open-source clients. Stores data only in Europe. Free with an optional paid plan.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_MANAGERS_BITWARDEN
context: Onboarding description of Bitwarden as a password manager option.
message: Secure and the most popular open-source password manager. Offers data storage in Europe or US. Free with an optional paid plan. Can be self-hosted.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_MANAGERS_ONE_PASSWORD
context: Onboarding description of 1Password as a password manager option.
message: Popular, paid, and closed-source password manager. Offers data storage in Europe or US. May not work correctly with Helium Neo without extra configuration.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_MANAGERS_DASHLANE
context: Onboarding description of Dashlane as a password manager option.
message: Popular, paid, and closed-source password manager. Stores data in Europe. Known for aggressive upselling tactics.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_MANAGERS_ICLOUD_PASSWORDS
context: Onboarding description of iCloud Passwords as a password manager option.
message: Free and closed-source password manager by Apple. Nags about using Safari, requires re-authentication on browser restart, and can't generate passwords.

name: IDS_HELIUM_ONBOARDING_PASSWORD_MANAGERS_KEE_PASS_XC
context: Onboarding description of KeePassXC as a password manager option.
message: Free, local, and open-source password manager for advanced users. Requires technical knowledge to set up and use. Cannot sync without extra software.
